name: Seers
overview: The Bible reveals that God communicates His will and secret plans through chosen servants, often called prophets or seers, emphasizing the divine origin and trustworthiness of their messages (Amos 3:7). The sacredness of God's Word is underscored by warnings against adding to or subtracting from it, ensuring the purity and completeness of His revelation (Deuteronomy 4:2; Revelation 22:18). The law and testimony of the Lord are described as perfect and sure, providing wisdom and spiritual restoration to believers (Psalms 19:7). Historical records, such as the book of Jasher mentioned in Joshua 10:13, attest to the reliability of God's works and the prophetic testimony preserved through time.
